_comment: kube-state-metrics gauge pair (deployment available vs spec replicas); emits one panel with three queries (desired, available, ratio) summed by namespace+deployment.

pair_metrics._comment: Pair partner — required for pair_with: explicit to resolve. Does not itself Match() the recipe (Match keys on status_replicas_available).
pair_metrics.name: kube_deployment_spec_replicas

negative_metrics._comment: Look-alike: total replicas (not available) — different name.
negative_metrics.name: kube_deployment_status_replicas

expected_panels.query_contains: sum by (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_status_replicas_available) / sum by (namespace, deployment) (kube_deployment_spec_replicas)
